mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id WHERE r.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId})

SELECT r.id AS recommendation_id, r.couple_id, r.updated_at, ( COALESCE(inviter_finance.has_high_rate_debt, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(invitee_finance.has_high_rate_debt, 0) = 1 ) AS has_high_interest_debt FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id INNER JOIN financial_summary inviter_finance ON inviter_finance.member_id = c.inviter_id INNER JOIN financial_summary invitee_finance ON invitee_finance.member_id = c.invitee_id WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}

SELECT rs.id AS slot_id, rs.slot_type, rp.product_id, rp.rank_no, rp.is_selected, p.product_name, p.description, p.url AS product_url, CASE WHEN rs.slot_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') THEN ( SELECT dr.base_rate FROM deposit_rate dr WHERE dr.deposit_id = rp.product_id AND LEAST(cs.target_period_months, d.max_term) >= dr.min_term AND ( dr.max_term IS NULL OR LEAST(cs.target_period_months, d.max_term) <= dr.max_term ) ORDER BY dr.min_term DESC, dr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS applicable_base_rate, i.risk_level, l.max_rate AS loan_max_rate FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id INNER JOIN invitation_code invitation ON invitation.id = c.invitation_code_id INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = invitation.common_survey_id INNER JOIN recommendation_slot rs ON rs.recommendation_id = r.id INNER JOIN recommendation_product rp ON rp.recommendation_slot_id = rs.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = rp.product_id LEFT JOIN deposit d ON d.id = p.id LEFT JOIN investment i ON i.id = p.id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.id = p.id WHERE r.id = #{recommendationId} AND (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}) ORDER BY CASE rs.slot_type WHEN 'DEPOSIT' THEN 1 WHEN 'SAVINGS' THEN 2 WHEN 'INVESTMENT' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOAN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, rp.rank_no

SELECT member.id AS target_member_id, member.name AS target_member_name, personal.product_id, personal.rank_no, product.product_name, product.description, product.url AS product_url, tax.account_type FROM personal_recommendation_tax_saving personal INNER JOIN member ON member.id = personal.member_id INNER JOIN product ON product.id = personal.product_id INNER JOIN tax_saving tax ON tax.id = product.id WHERE personal.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY personal.rank_no

SELECT member.id AS target_member_id, member.name AS target_member_name, personal.product_id, personal.rank_no, product.product_name, product.description, product.url AS product_url, investment.risk_level FROM personal_recommendation_investment personal INNER JOIN member ON member.id = personal.member_id INNER JOIN product ON product.id = personal.product_id INNER JOIN investment ON investment.id = product.id WHERE personal.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY personal.rank_no

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId} ) THEN FALSE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id INNER JOIN invitation_code invitation ON invitation.id = c.invitation_code_id INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = invitation.common_survey_id WHERE (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}) AND ( cs.updated_at > r.updated_at OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member WHERE id IN (c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id) AND updated_at > r.updated_at ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM personal_survey WHERE member_id IN (c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id) AND updated_at > r.updated_at ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM financial_summary WHERE member_id IN (c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id) AND updated_at > r.updated_at ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pension_isa_account WHERE member_id IN (c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id) AND updated_at > r.updated_at ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product WHERE updated_at > r.updated_at ) ) ) THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation (couple_id) VALUES (#{coupleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO recommendation_product ( recommendation_slot_id, product_id, rank_no, is_selected ) VALUES ( #{slotId}, #{product.productId}, #{product.rank}, #{product.selected} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_product rp INNER JOIN recommendation_slot rs ON rs.id = rp.recommendation_slot_id WHERE rs.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_product rp INNER JOIN recommendation_slot rs ON rs.id = rp.recommendation_slot_id WHERE rs.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} AND rp.is_selected = 1
